subject: License recommitment & PO acceleration for Q3 capacity increase
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@globex.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@globex.co
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Recommitment and increased license for Q3

Hi Jonas,

We're preparing for a Q3 ramp and want to extend our existing license one year with an immediate 40% capacity uplift (additional token throughput and reserved concurrency). Legal signoff is straightforward, but procurement needs a clean path to raise a PO and expedite payment.

Can you confirm:
- Updated term and pricing for a +40% capacity uplift (one-year extension)
- A single PO line item and a consolidated invoice cadence
- SOC 2 evidence and any needed SLA addendum

Our target is to have a PO raised by Friday 14 May and start capacity on 1 June. I'm copying our procurement inbox for the PO process.

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Procurement Manager
Globex Corporation

Attachments: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@globex.co>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recommitment and increased license for Q3

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask. I'm looping in Marissa (sales ops/legal liaison) and Aditya (rev ops) so we can scope the PO-ready items and get you a single-line pricing sheet.

Quick answers:
- We'll prepare a one-year extension with a +40% capacity SKU and a consolidated invoice cadence (monthly).
- I'll push SOC 2 summary and the SLA addendum for your review.
- If procurement can share the PO template, Marissa can author the contract header to match your PO.

I'll follow up with the draft contract and a DocuSign link today.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recommitment and increased license for Q3

Jonas / Aditya —

I'll prepare a short extension addendum that aligns with a single-line PO. Items I need from procurement (procure@globex.co):
1) Exact billing entity name and remit address
2) PO number format and any internal approval codes to surface on the invoice
3) Contact for invoice submission and accounting lead for payment ETA

I've attached a draft extension and a one-page SOC 2 summary (not full report). Proposed commercial notes: 12-month extension, effective 2027-06-01, SKU: RED-STD-40P, unit: reserved throughput; invoice monthly net 30. If procurement can provide the PO by 2027-05-14 we can meet the go-live on 2027-06-01.

I'll mark the contract header placeholders to match whatever they provide so we don't have to iterate on DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

I'll open the DocuSign envelope once we have the PO header and number. For transparency I'm also looping Aditya to review billing cadence.
